metaTitle: USB-C Power Delivery Explained for Campers
description: Learn how USB-C Power Delivery works, which wattage and cable your phone or laptop needs, and why a power bank may charge a laptop slowly or not at all.
directAnswer: USB-C Power Delivery lets a charger and device negotiate voltage and current. Phones need about 20 to 30 W, ultrabooks 45 to 65 W and larger laptops up to 100 W, and 100 W needs a 5 A e-marked cable.
